responsibility_boundary: The pnpm lockfile is the generated dependency-closure authority for the public npm workspace inventory; this waiver extends that exact closure only for the new @kungfu-tech/work package.
cohesion_rationale: The nine added lines are the deterministic workspace importer for Work and its existing Spec and Ajv dependencies; splitting or hand-editing the generated lockfile would weaken reproducibility.
rejected_split_alternatives: A separate lockfile or an undeclared workspace package would break the monorepo package boundary and frozen installation contract.
affected_tests_and_qualification: ./shifu check:framework-layout; ./shifu test:work-package; ./shifu qualify:work-package; ./shifu check:npm-package-registry; ./shifu check:source; Candidate source acceptance / check; Delivery Warrant; merge_group.
